lines: Thukrao ab ke pyaar karo, main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: Turn me away or love me, I am drunk.

lines: Jo chaho mere yaar karo, main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: Do as you wish, my dear, I am drunk.

lines: Thukrao ab ke pyaar karo, main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: Turn me away or love me, I am drunk.

lines: Ab bhi dila raha hoon yaqeen-e-wafa magar
couplets.en: Even now I am trying to assure you of my faithfulness.

lines: Mera na aitbaar karo, main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: Put no faith in my word, I am drunk.

lines: Main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: I am drunk.

lines: Girne do tum mujhe, mera saaghar sambhaal lo
couplets.en: Let me fall, but keep my wine cup safe.

lines: Itna to mere yaar karo, main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: Do this much for me, my dear, I am drunk.

lines: Main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: I am drunk.

lines: Mujhko qadam qadam pe bhatakne do waaiz
couplets.en: Let me lose my way at every step, preacher.

lines: Tum apna kaarobaar karo, main nashe mein hoon
couplets.en: See to your own affairs, I am drunk.

lines: Phir bekhudi mein had se guzarne laga hoon main
couplets.en: Lost to myself again, I am beginning to go too far.

lines: Phir bekhudi mein
